en: My hero! My butler has been fussing over me ever since I came home.
Oh, but while you are here, would you hear one little wish of mine?
I do so long to see a {species:VAR_RESORT_GORGEOUS_REQUESTED_MON} with my own eyes.
Would you be a dear and bring one to my door?
I should dearly love to see some rare Pokémon, but I know of none at all.
Travel a little and tell me what you find!
Oh! Oh, is that a {species:VAR_RESORT_GORGEOUS_REQUESTED_MON} with you?
You brought one all this way, for me? You darling creature!
A token of my appreciation for my hero, if you please. The good one.
I shall do as you bid, my lady.
Her ladyship asks that you accept this with her thanks.
I shall think of something else I simply must see.
Until then, my hero, I wish you the very best of luck!
